title: Max Speed Outlier Runs
dataSources: Slopes ski sessions (`slopes:session`), Ski Tracks runs (`skitracks:run`), OnTheSnow resort reports (`onthesnow:report`), snow safety checks (`snow:safety`), and Ikon Pass lift scans (`ikon:pass`).
app: Slopes ski sessions, Ski Tracks GPS runs, OnTheSnow resort reports, snow safety checklist logs, and Ikon Pass scan exports forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=skitracks:run max_speed_kph=* trail_name=*
| eventstats avg(max_speed_kph) as avg_speed, stdev(max_speed_kph) as speed_stdev by trail_name
| eval z_score=round((max_speed_kph-avg_speed)/nullif(speed_stdev,0),2)
| where z_score>=2
| table _time trail_name max_speed_kph avg_speed z_score
description: Detects Ski Tracks runs whose max speed is two standard deviations above the trail average.
value: Speed outliers can flag icy conditions, GPS glitches, or runs where control got away from you.
implementation: Export Ski Tracks runs with `max_speed_kph` and review z-score outliers after each resort day.
visualization: Scatter plot of max speed by trail with outlier markers.
grandmaExplanation: It spots runs where you went unusually fast compared with your normal pace on that trail.
